headline: China-linked hackers use PHP2Shell to root firewalls a day before CISA's deadline; Node2Shell exploited; Adobe fixes 8 critical Campaign flaws

bullets.text: New: China-linked hackers are exploiting PHP2Shell to gain root on firewalls. PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) leads at 8 outlets; CISA's federal due date is tomorrow, 2026-10-29. Fixes are in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.
CISA warns that hackers are now exploiting the critical Node2Shell flaw. Treat it as active exploitation and follow vendor guidance for fixed releases.

New: Adobe fixed 8 critical Campaign Classic flaws (including CVE-2026-104351) allowing code execution and security bypass. PolyShell attacks on Adobe Commerce have breached hundreds of stores; CVE-2026-48356 (Magento) and Brotli CVE-2026-111497 are in CISA KEV, due 2026-11-10.

Breaches: Sony-owned So-net lost 2.6 million customer records; 123 Reg disclosed an 'AI cyberattack' on customer data and suspects a China nexus; GMO offers a $1 million bounty over its FX trading cloud breach. Ransomware is still disrupting care at UNM Health.

New: a Ukrainian national was sentenced for ransomware conspiracies against hospitals, businesses and governments causing over $100 million in losses; an $11 million reward is offered for a co-conspirator.

Supply chain: the LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromise on PyPI and Docker began with an exposed master key; a worm armed 42 GitHub repos and 'Gheist' uses stolen GitHub tokens to steal cloud secrets. Last 7 days at 1.03x the 90-day average.

actions: Update PHP to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 today, including on firewalls and appliances that run PHP, and check exposed hosts for compromise.
Find any Node2Shell-affected systems you run, apply the vendor's fix now and check exposed hosts for compromise.
Apply Adobe's Campaign Classic update and patch Adobe Commerce/Magento for CVE-2026-48356; check stores for webshells and unexpected uploads.
Apply Microsoft's emergency .NET patches for Brotli CVE-2026-111497 and track fixes from other software that bundles Brotli.
Apply Tailscale's SSH fixes on nodes that use Tailscale SSH.
Search lockfiles, images and CI caches for litellm 1.107.0; if it ran, treat the host as compromised and rotate every credential it could read.
